taste.name: Depth by Contrast, Not by Weight
taste.trigger: Separating event metadata, a registration widget, and long bilingual body copy on one screen
taste.decision: Flat grey field + 0.5px inset hairlines over drop-shadowed elevated cards
taste.reason: A near-invisible edge marks a distinct thing without making the eye process a glow around every block, so the one true shadow can mean 'this is the important widget'
evidence: exactly one drop shadow 0 1px 4px, on the registration card

taste.name: Color Is Information, Not Identity
taste.trigger: Deciding how much brand amber to spend across CTA, links, badges, icons
taste.decision: Amber only on the 'Require Approval' concept; primary CTA painted neutral #141414
taste.reason: If everything interactive is colored, color stops meaning anything — reserving amber for one gate makes a glance down the ticket list tell you which options will make you wait
evidence: 'Request to Join' button is #141414, not amber

taste.name: One Web Font, Spent at the Top
taste.trigger: Deciding how many typefaces to load for a page that is 95% dense bilingual informational text
taste.decision: Load Google Sans Flex for the h1 alone; render everything else in the native -apple-system stack
taste.reason: A visitor deciding whether to RSVP wants instant paint and text that reads like their own OS — one branded headline buys identity, and web-font body text would only slow first paint
evidence: Google Sans Flex = 8 uses, h1 only (48px/575)

taste.name: Trusted Whitespace Over the Card Reflex
taste.trigger: Laying out a long description with sub-sections where the easy move is to box each in a card
taste.decision: Flat left-aligned text separated by whitespace and hairline rules; cards reserved for actionable content only
taste.reason: Cards signal 'act on me' — using them for read-only prose cries wolf, so the one card that matters (registration) loses its pull. Whitespace groups text just as well
evidence: only 2 card components exist (cover + registration), both actionable
18px paragraph rhythm with hairline rules under section heads
